description: Record a typed edge between any two stored entities — models, prompts, artifacts, maps, collections, or anything else addressed by a content id — with no fixed predicate vocabulary: the caller's choice ("hasMember", "cites", "supersedes", whatever the relationship actually is). Distinct from the Lineage a model/prompt/artifact already carries, which is specifically derivation (parent -> prompt -> child); a Relation is any OTHER assertion about how two entities relate, including sim_create_collection's own membership edges. Linking the same subject/predicate/object again as the same user is idempotent: it returns the existing relation's id (existing: true) rather than recording a duplicate edge.

object.description: id of the entity the relation points to

predicate.description: the relationship, e.g. hasMember, cites, supersedes — no fixed vocabulary

subject.description: id of the entity the relation starts from

name: sim_link
